CustomField.description: The Apex class that actually ran, as resolved at runtime from the config. Recorded separately from Source__c because the provider is selected by a config STRING: if the configured class is renamed or deleted there is no compile error, and this field is the only evidence of what really executed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The provider class that ran. Compare against the configured value if a run behaves unexpectedly.
CustomField.label: Provider Class Name
